rooms.name: Start
rooms.desc: Nothing much here.

rooms.name: A Mountain Pass
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the edge of a narrow pass through these mountains.
The air here is cold and the elevation is dizzying, your view of the land
below is partially obscured by cloud cover.  Before you, you see a rocky, narrow
switchback that leads even higher up into the mountains. Dense clouds
obscure your view up the mountain after awhile, although you can acertain
that the peak is much higher than you can see at the moment.  The narrow
pass continues to the north.

rooms.name: A Mountain Path
rooms.desc:
This path leads to the top of the mountain. It's not very steep here 
towards the bottom but it looks like it gets steeper more towards the
top.

rooms.name: A Mountain Path
rooms.desc:
The path up this mountain continues to grow slightly steeper as you 
near the top of the mountain.  You can start to make out dim shapes 
through the mists.

rooms.name: A Mountain Path
rooms.desc:
The path continues up the side of the mountain and is progressively 
getting steeper and steeper. A small, rocky path to the east looks like 
the only other alternative to heading up or down the mountain.

rooms.name: A Path On The Side Of The Mountain
rooms.desc:
This path seems to lead around to the other side of the mountain. 
There are no signs of recent travel however; the trail is rocky and
overgrown. The top of the mountain is still very difficult to see.

rooms.name: A Path On The Side Of The Mountain
rooms.desc:
The side path continues to wrap around to the other side of the
mountain and does not seem to get you any closer to the top. The
trail here is so narrow that you have to hold your breath to keep
from losing balance and plummeting to your death.

rooms.name: A Path On The Side Of The Mountain
rooms.desc:
The path continues to wrap around the side of the mountain. You can 
hear an odd, low hum coming from further along the path.

rooms.name: The Steps Before The Temple
rooms.desc:
As you come around a bend in the path you see that there have been 
steps carved into the side of the mountain. The steps lead several 
hundred feet up to the gates of a temple. From the temple can be heard 
a low, eerie hum, which sounds strangely familiar at times.  The mist 
is still very thick here, and you can tell that there are even higher 
peaks above this section of the mountain.

rooms.name: Climbing The Stairs To The Temple
rooms.desc:
As you climb the many stairs to the temple above you notice that none 
of the stairs show the effects of the elements or time. The low hum grows
louder but no more discernible than before.

rooms.name: Before the Temple
rooms.desc:
You stand before a massive temple carved out of the side of the 
mountain. The rock has been carved and polished to be as smooth as 
marble. It shows no signs of time or the elements. The temple itself 
looks to be the same as any traditional Shaolin temple. To each side of 
the last flight of stairs to the entrance are two huge dragons carved 
from obsidian. In each dragon's mouth burns an eerie, unnatural fire. 
The low humming you heard as you approached is now discernible as 
chanting coming from deep within the temple.

rooms.name: The Temple Gates
rooms.desc:
You stand before the gates of the temple. The gates appear as though
they were forged from iron and have an intricate bronze lion on each
half. Just beyond the gate is a courtyard leading to the temple itself.

rooms.name: The Temple Court Yard
rooms.desc:
You stand in the court yard of the temple. The mountain rises high into
the skies above you. The top of the mountain is shrouded in clouds, making
it difficult to see what lies above. The courtyard extends in all directions
and the main temple lies to the north.

rooms.name: The Temple Court Yard
rooms.desc:
You stand in the southwestern corner of the temple courtyard. The
mountain rises high into the skies above you, its peak obscured by a
shroud of clouds.

rooms.name: The Temple Court Yard
rooms.desc:
You stand in the southeastern corner of the temple courtyard. The
mountain rises high above you into the heavens.  A shroud of clouds
makes it hard to see the very top of the mountain.

rooms.name: The Temple Court Yard
rooms.desc:
You stand in the courtyard of the temple. The mountain rises high
above you into the heavens. A shroud of clouds obscures the mountain
top making it difficult to discern what lies above.

rooms.name: The Temple Courtyard
rooms.desc:
You stand in the center of the temple's courtyard. From here you can
see the mountain rise high into skies above you. The top of the mountain
is still difficult to see because of the clouds shrouding it.  Looking
around you, you see the elaborate structure of the main temple as it is
framed against the sharp rise of the mountain, your breath catching in
your throat by its splendor.

rooms.name: The Temple Courtyard
rooms.desc:
You stand in the temple courtyard. The mountain rises high above
you, the clouds shrouding its top making it difficult to see what
lies above.  You are just south of the main temple building here.

rooms.name: The Temple Courtyard
rooms.desc:
You stand in the northeastern corner of the temple courtyard. The
mountain, Kaim-Morgul, reaches high into the heavens above you, its
peak shrouded by a thick layer of clouds that make it difficult to
see how tall the mountain really is.

rooms.name: The Temple Courtyard
rooms.desc:
You stand in the temple courtyard just before the temple entrance.
The mountain rises high above the temple and into the skies above. 
Chanting from inside the temple sends its sound reverberating through 
your body and penetrates your very being.

rooms.name: The Temple Courtyard
rooms.desc:
You stand in the northwestern corner of the temple courtyard. The
mountain looms high above you in the skies. A layer of clouds covers
the top of the mountain, making it difficult to see what lies above.

rooms.name: Inside The Temple
rooms.desc:
You stand just inside this magnificent and ancient temple.  A
small mat rests in front of a tiny stone altar presumably used for
prayer. The room is lit by four ornate bronze braziers. The chanting
of what can only be monks reverberates through the room and seems to
have no end.

rooms.name: The Temple Sanctorum
rooms.desc:
You stand in the entrance to a long stone chamber. This seems to be a 
gathering place for prayer and meditation. Each wall is supported by a 
huge pillar, and on each pillar is a bas-relief of a lion's head. Inside 
each of the lion's mouth burns an unnatural flame. The eerie chanting 
of monks seems to endlessly echo off of the vaulted ceiling high above 
you.

rooms.name: The Temple Sanctorum
rooms.desc:
You stand in the entrance to a long stone chamber. This seems to be a 
gathering place for prayer and meditation. Each wall is supported by a 
huge pillar, and on each pillar is a bas-relief of a lion's head. Inside 
each of the lion's mouth burns an unnatural flame. The eerie chanting 
of monks seems to endlessly echo off of the vaulted ceiling high above 
you.

rooms.name: Before The Master
rooms.desc:
You stand at the northernmost end of the temple sanctorum.  Several
well-used mats lie strewn across the floor for meditation purposes.
Beneath a cyclopean sandstone sculpture of the Buddha, there is a 
simple raised wooden platform. It is from here that the master of the 
temple leads the others in meditation and reflection.  In the dim 
candlelight of this end of the sanctorum, you notice robed figures
moving about with a sense of purpose in the darkness.  Even from here
you can still hear the endless chanting echoing off the walls and
ceilings of this place.

rooms.name: A Poorly Lit Corridor
rooms.desc:
As you wander through the temple, you find yourself in a poorly lit 
corridor adjoining the sanctorum. The little light that there is is 
provided by small bronze lanterns mounted on the walls. The walls are 
smooth and cool to the touch. The ceaseless chanting reverberates off 
of the corridor walls maddeningly.

rooms.name: A Large Open Room
rooms.desc:
You stand in a large open room. There are many wooden frames with 
thin mattresses neatly ranked and filed. This is most likely where
the monks sleep.

rooms.name: A Poorly Lit Corridor
rooms.desc:
As you wander through the temple, you find yourself in a poorly lit
corridor adjoining the sanctorum. The little light that there is is 
provided by small bronze lanterns mounted on the walls. The walls are 
smooth and cool to the touch. The ceaseless chanting reverberates off 
of the corridor walls maddeningly.

rooms.name: A Dry Cellar
rooms.desc:
This is where the monks keep their stocks of non perishable food and 
clothing. The clothing is kept on sturdy wooden shelves. The food, most
of which is rice, is kept in large ceramic pots on the floor with a dry
cloth covering the opening to keep dust and mites out.

rooms.name: A Harrowing Switchback
rooms.desc:
The trail curves wildly here, and you have to pick at the rocks and
runt trees for handholds.  As you pause to catch your breath before continuing
to navigate the final part of this switchback, you notice that you are 
completely surrounded by fog.  You are perplexed until you realize:
You must be standing inside of a cloud!

rooms.name: A Mountain Path
rooms.desc:
From here you can see the path is about to become much more steep 
then it was until now. The mountain peak is shrouded by a layer of
clouds, but it looks like there might be something up there.

rooms.name: A Steep Mountain Path
rooms.desc:
As you pause for a moment to catch you breath, you notice a small
cave just off the path to your west.  Is it your imagination, or do
you see a flicker of light emanating from it?  The path has gotten
much steeper and more rocky; you almost need climbing gear to continue
up.

rooms.name: A Dark Cave
rooms.desc:
This cave seems very warm and comfortable, and definitely inhabited. 
There are rags piled up on the floor and some assorted personal items 
scattered about, including climbing gear and hunting equipment.  The 
light you noticed from outside is actually a small fire, which serves
to keep the cave warm, albeit smoky.

rooms.name: A Steep Mountain Path
rooms.desc:
As you climb along the steep mountain path you can see that there is 
indeed something at the top of the mountain. Looking down, you realize
that it would be a very nasty fall down the side of the mountain.

rooms.name: A Steep Mountain Path
rooms.desc:
The air is starting to get thinner this high up on the mountain path, 
and you gasp for breath.  The the clouds are starting to look like they
are just out of reach. On the top of the mountain you think you can make
out what appears to be a building of some sort.  Undaunted, you press on.

rooms.name: A Steep Mountain Path
rooms.desc:
Stopping to catch what little breath you can in this thin air you take a
moment to look around. Far below you is the base of the mountain, and the
small pagoda.  Further from your sight, you notice what could be another
complex on the east side of the mountain. Looking up you can see an odd
building, clearly a pagoda, at the mountain's peak.  It appears to be much
bigger than the one at the base of the mountain.
   The clouds surround you here.  Oddly enough, this high up they feel
unusually warm.

rooms.name: A Steep Mountain Path
rooms.desc:
As you progress further along the path, the clouds have now surrounded
you and made it difficult to see. In fact, the only visible thing you can
make out is the pagoda at the mountaintop.

rooms.name: A Steep Mountain Path
rooms.desc:
The clouds around you seem to become thicker as you climb along the 
steep mountain path. The pagoda at the mountain's peak seems to glow
unnaturally, as if it had a flaming aura around it.

rooms.name: A Steep Mountain Path
rooms.desc:
As you pause for a moment to regain your strength you notice the
air is easier to breath, though unusually warm for this altitude.
The clouds are beginning to thin out again as you climb towards the
pagoda.

rooms.name: A Steep Mountain Path
rooms.desc:
After climbing the mountain path for seemingly forever, you note that
you are almost at the top of the mountain. The clouds seem to disappear
just before the mountain's peak.

rooms.name: The Mountain Peak
rooms.desc:
As you reach the top of the mountain, you quickly turn back towards
the path so you can soak in your accomplishment. Unfortunately, though,
the clouds stretch as far as you can see, completely obscuring the 
surrounding area.
   As you turn around, you can see a traditional-style pagoda.  The
pagoda seems to glow with an unnatural, fiery aura.

rooms.name: On A Narrow Ledge
rooms.desc:
You stand on a narrow ledge. Far below you, in what would be a fatal 
fall, is the bottom of the mountain. You hug the side of the mountain,
struggling not to lose your balance.
   After a calming breath, you catch something glimmering out on a limb
just north of here.

rooms.name: Out On A Limb
rooms.desc:
As you carefully crawl out on a limb to see what was glimmering, you
hear the limb creak.  Holding your breath, the creaking stops, and you
question your motives for negotiating this pine branch.  The limb sways
slightly in the wind.
   As you look back up, you notice what was glimmering before is in fact
a fire falcon. It slowly turns towards you and takes to flight, shaking
the limb violently.  You hear a loud creaking come from the limb and,
suddenly, you feel weightless as the limb gives way.
   High above you can hear the shrill cry of the falcon, its shriek a
mocking laughter as you plummet to your death.

rooms.name: Before the Fire Pagoda
rooms.desc:
You stand before a three level Pagoda. The Pagoda glows with a fiery 
aura which makes the air unnaturally warm for this altitude. The Pagoda
itself is ornately detailed and masterfully constructed. A short set of
stone stairs leads to the double-door entrance.

rooms.name: Entrance To The Pagoda
rooms.desc:
You stand just inside what seems to be a magnificently built pagoda.
The doors are ornately carved from a beautiful teak wood. The walls are
plain white, but are elegantly tasteful. The floor is constructed from 
a rich, dark hardwood that has been carefully polished and maintained.
The room itself is presumably where guests wait to be announced to the
owner of this fine home.

rooms.name: Inside the Fire Pagoda
rooms.desc:
You are just beyond the entrance of the Fire Pagoda, in a large room 
obviously used for assembling large groups of people, but as for what
purpose, you cannot tell.  The floor is made of a highly polished wood,
possibly teak, and creaks and flexes as you walk on it, as though it is
suspended above the natural flooring. Giant basalt pillars hold up the
ceiling; you wonder how the floor can possibly support their weight.
A broad flight of stone steps leads upward in the northern part of this 
room, and the rest of the room extends in all directions.

rooms.name: Inside the Fire Pagoda
rooms.desc:
You are in the southeast corner of what appears to be the only chamber 
on the ground floor of this pagoda.  Many torches line the walls of this 
chamber, but it doesn't seem to help the light any; it is as if the walls 
absorb the torches energy inside of allowing it to radiate into the room.  
Hot, fibrous refuse drips continually from the torches, and you wonder 
how they can possibly afford to have a wooden floor with all this open 
flame around.  Upon closer inspection of the floor, however, you notice 
that it has been treated with a wax-like substance which is apparently 
fireproof, judging by the condition of the wood.  Men in crimson robes 
attend to the torches ceaselessly, their cowls pulled up over their faces.

rooms.name: Inside the Fire Pagoda
rooms.desc:
You are in the southwest corner of the ground chamber in the pagoda.  
Men in dark crimson robes tend to the torches and braziers that are
seemingly everywhere in this room: on the walls, the stone support
pillars, in corners, and suspended on heavy iron chains from the flat
ceiling.  Funny thing that the torches don't seem to be providing much 
light -- probably because of the immense size of the chamber.

rooms.name: Inside the Fire Pagoda
rooms.desc:
You stand in the northwestern section of the first level of the Fire
Pagoda.  From here you can clearly see that there must be hundreds of
thousands of torches, candles, and braziers in this one chamber alone.
The building itself seems to be absorbing the energy from these torches
as the walls seem fairly warm to the touch.  Perhaps these torches are
what is fueling the flaming aura that surrounds the outside of this
place.

rooms.name: Inside the Fire Pagoda
rooms.desc:
This is the northern section of the first floor of the Fire Pagoda.
A flight of flanked stone steps leads upward to the next level, each
step bearing a tall candle at each end.  The shadows and flickering
generated by all the open flames in this chamber, though limited, still
sends an eerie chill down your spine.  The men in crimson robes walk
about this chamber with great urgency, chanting eerily as they do so.

rooms.name: Inside the Fire Pagoda
rooms.desc:
This is the northeast corner of the Fire Pagoda's ground chamber.
A long flight of steep, flanked steps leads upward to your west.
Smudge pots and ornate braziers line the walls and floor here, tended
by monks in odd crimson robes.  You'd hate to think what would happen
if one of these things were knocked over accidentally.

rooms.name: Fire Pagoda
rooms.desc:
This floor looks to be much the same as the one below it, teak flooring 
and basalt columns supporting a flat ceiling.  Torches, braziers, and 
other open flames burn everywhere, as before.  This level, however, has
four large windows: two set in the eastern wall, and two set opposite
them in the western.  The windows look out into the clouds through a
fiery veil, the same that surrounds the temple from the outside.  The
chanting of the servants of the pagoda seems louder here than it did 
before, and the room extends to another upward flight of stairs to the 
south.

rooms.name: Fire Pagoda
rooms.desc:
The second level of the pagoda seems to be much the same as the first, 
except that this level seems unnaturally warm.  Perhaps it is because of 
the large column of flame that leaps from the floor to the southeast of 
here, almost in the exact centre of the room.  Torches, smudge pots, 
braziers, and all manner of other devices designed to protect fire are 
scattered haphazardly about this chamber, tended by the Servants and 
their acolytes.

rooms.name: Fire Pagoda
rooms.desc:
The pagoda looks eerie from your angle, the interior light buffeting 
and reflecting from the glow in the windows, making crazed, jagged-edged
angles on the walls and columns.  The servants of the Flame move in and
out of these shadowed angles rapidly, like flies buzzing around a fresh
corpse, or moths to a flame.

rooms.name: Fire Pagoda
rooms.desc:
You stand in the glow from a gigantic window on this level.
Everything outside looks orange, as you gaze through the soft
flame-like glow. Not like there is much to see, of course; 
Thick cloud-cover prevents you from seeing anything save the 
highest peaks of the Grey Mountains.

rooms.name: A Column of Flame
rooms.desc:
The centre of this chamber is dominated by a huge column of flame 
that ejaculates from the floor.  The flame is contained by magical
runes carved on the floor and the ceiling.  The flame itself appears
to continue through the ceiling on to the roof.
   The second floor extends in all directions from here.

rooms.name: Fire Pagoda
rooms.desc:
You stand in the glow from a gigantic window on this level.  
Everything outside looks orange, as you gaze through the soft 
flame-like glow. Not like there is much to see, of course;
Thick cloud-cover prevents you from seeing anything save the
highest peaks of the Grey Mountains.

rooms.name: Fire Pagoda
rooms.desc:
You stand in the shadow of a broad flight of stone steps that lead
to the next level directly to the east.  Tall red candles guard the
sides of each step as they ascend.  Hot, sticky air rolls down from
the steps, assaulting your senses.  The walls and floor look slightly
less glossy here than in other places, probably due to their exposure
to the elements by way of the open stairway.

rooms.name: Fire Pagoda
rooms.desc:
This is the base of the stairs that ascend into semidarkness to 
what is presumably the third and final level of the pagoda.  You
suspect that the upper level must be open and unprotected from the
elements to some degree, because hot, moist air blows down from
above, making you uncomfortable.  You notice that this moisture-
laden air has caused small patches of crimson-coloured lichen to
form on the stairs and floor here.

rooms.name: Fire Pagoda
rooms.desc:
This corner of the pagoda is abnormally damp, as if moisture was
allowed to collect here for some period of time.  The dampness is
more than likely a result of the open stairway to your west, and the
burning column of fire in the centre of the room does little to
alleviate the dampness and darkness here.  There is even a surprising
lack of torches and the like.
   Upon closer inspection, you notice that the wax-like substance that
covers the rest of the walls and floor is practically non-existent
here.  Perhaps this room isn't safe for open flame right now.

rooms.name: The Top Level
rooms.desc:
As you climb to the top level, you realize that the stairway that you
are on is set into a lipped stone well; the actual floor is behind you,
to the north.  The view into the clouds ahead of you is breathtaking
though.
   The flames around the pagoda seem to subside at the top here.  This
floor is indeed roofed, as you saw from the outside, but it is open air,
without walls.  The ceiling is instead supported by magnificent columns
of red marble.  The rest of this floor is accessible by walking around
the well to the north.

rooms.name: A Column of Fire
rooms.desc:
This is where the column of fire from the level below comes through
the floor. It continues up its magickal path through a large portal in 
the arched ceiling and out in to the night sky.  Though it appears to
be ornamental, you can only guess at its actual purpose.  The heat and
moisture here are almost unbearable, causing your clothes and armor to
stick to you when you move, and sweat to drip from your brow.  The 
floor extends to the east and west, and to the north there seems to be 
some kind of throne set up.

rooms.name: The Top Level
rooms.desc:
This is the western half of the top floor, where spirits of fire 
dance around the cylindrical pillar of flame in ecstasy.  Intense,
superheated air stirs around you, choking you with its vile thickness.
All around you are servants of the great master, Fire, and you have
no doubt that you are in his Temple.

rooms.name: The Top Level
rooms.desc:
This is the eastern half of the top level, where spirits of the flames 
dance and twist in wild ecstasy around the centre pillar of fire.  Of this 
you can have no doubt: This is the legendary shrine of Fire -- The Fire 
Pagoda.  You stand in awe of its magnificence.

rooms.name: On A Dais
rooms.desc:
You stand on a slightly elevated dais at the northern end of the top 
level of the Fire Pagoda.  All around you, flame spirits dance wildly
around the pillar of flame in the center of this place.  The magical
nature of this place is certain. This is one of the shrines of the 
elements that make up this world -- the legendary Fire Pagoda!
   Before you, on a massive golden throne, stands the master and High
Priest of this pagoda, a soft blue flame outlining his figure.
